dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.line: Beyond the Celestial Confluence, a forgotten path led into a garden of brass and stone.

dialogue.speaker: Jeeah
dialogue.line: Look, Eldrin. Someone built an entire garden around that crystal.

dialogue.speaker: Eldrin
dialogue.line: Remarkable. Its mechanisms have been silent for a very long time.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.line: A sudden crackle interrupted the silence.

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.line: Oh! That was supposed to happen. Well… most of it.

dialogue.speaker: Eldrin
dialogue.line: An unconventional greeting, I must say.

dialogue.speaker: Jeeah
dialogue.line: Are you all right?

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.line: Perfectly fine! I'm Tessa, wandering inventor. And this little troublemaker is Pip.

dialogue.speaker: Jeeah
dialogue.line: I'm Jeeah. This is Eldrin. We've been restoring the elemental currents.

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.line: Then you two are exactly who I've been looking for!

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.line: I've mapped the garden, but I can't get its six currents to work together. Care to try?

dialogue.speaker: Eldrin
dialogue.line: The inscriptions suggest each mechanism responds to a different element.

dialogue.speaker: Jeeah
dialogue.line: Let's see what we can do together.

dialogue.speaker: Eldrin
dialogue.line: The Heart of Wonders will awaken only when every current reaches its inlet.

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.line: Fire, Water, Plant, Electricity, Wind and Arcane. Six deliveries, one garden.

dialogue.speaker: Jeeah
dialogue.line: Then let's bring it back to life.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.line: The six currents converged. The Heart of Wonders awakened.

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.line: It works! Every single mechanism!

dialogue.speaker: Jeeah
dialogue.line: It's beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: Eldrin
dialogue.line: A splendid reminder of what can be achieved together.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.line: One of the newly awakened fountains had a surprise for Eldrin.

dialogue.speaker: Eldrin
dialogue.line: I believe the fountain is rather enthusiastic.

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.line: At least we know the water pressure is excellent!

dialogue.speaker: Jeeah
dialogue.line: Careful, Pip! You're next.

dialogue.speaker: Jeeah
dialogue.line: We're heading into the next realm. Would you like to join us?

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.line: More forgotten inventions? More mysteries? Absolutely!

dialogue.speaker: Eldrin
dialogue.line: I suspect our journey is about to become considerably less quiet.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.line: The northern gate opened onto a realm of floating paths and impossible bridges.

dialogue.speaker: Tessa
dialogue.line: Look at those structures! Pip, wait for us!

dialogue.speaker: Jeeah
dialogue.line: The next current is waiting.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.line: Three companions and one little inventor's creation set out together.

dialogue.speaker: Eldrin
dialogue.line: There is much yet to discover.

dialogue.speaker: Jeeah
dialogue.line: And we'll discover it together.
